history.recommendation_text: 23. The Board recommends that the Administration increase backup wide-body aircraft utilization before entering into a short-term contract or letter of assist.
history.reference_raw: A/72/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year ended 30 June 2017; para. 153
history.administration_response: The Department of Field Support stated that the transfer of the operational and tasking control from United Nations Headquarters to the Strategic Air Operations Centre in early 2018 is expected to optimize the use of backup wide-body aircraft. The Procurement Division provided additional evidence for increasing the utilization of the backup aircraft through a contract amendment.
history.board_assessment: The recommendation is considered to be implemented.
